results.title: William Wyler: Forty Takes Willy
results.overview: Documentary on the life and career of famed director William Wyler. An Academy Award-winning director and 14-time Oscar nominee, Wyler was known for shooting multiple takes of a scene before he was satisfied. This documentary takes a deep dive into his extraordinary career, featuring never-before-seen material provided by Wyler's children.

results.title: Bruce Springsteen: Nebraska Live
results.overview: Bruce Springsteen performs the songs from his 1982 album “Nebraska” for the first time ever in its entirety in an intimate soundstage setting. Shot in moody black-and-white, the film is directed by Springsteen’s longtime filmic collaborator Thom Zimny.

results.title: Truth or Dare
results.overview: Puck and Jasko explore their bodies for the first time. Sexworker Jorge feels shy towards porn performer Bishop. Kate & Adrienne end their poly-relationship & dive into a bittersweet sexual en-counter. The film offers an intimate perspective in the discourse about gender diversity and sex-positivity.

results.title: A bocca chiusa
results.overview: "Mouth shut" is a character-driven psychological drama unfolding through a psychiatric session with Agata, an out-of-town university student living alone in Bologna and struggling with an eating disorder she cannot fully acknowledge. At the core of Agata’s condition lies a paradox: her inability to recognize her own illness. Within her, a constant conflict between rationality and irrationality takes shape, as she remains suspended between the urge to fight and the temptation to embrace what has become an integral part of her identity. Through her internal struggle, the film offers an intimate lens on an often invisible illness, exploring how social perceptions and stereotypes prevent those affected from recognizing themselves, and being recognized, as “sick enough” to deserve care and attention. "Mouth shut" provides a raw yet delicate glimpse into an increasingly pervasive reality, aiming to raise awareness by inviting the audience not to rely on what they see, but on what they feel.

results.title: Stardom 15th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League in Iwaki
results.original_title: 第15回 ゴッデス・オブ・スターダム ～タッグリーグ戦～ in IWAKI
results.overview: 15th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League in Iwaki was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom. It took place on November 24, 2025, at Iwaki City Gymnasium in Iwaki, Fukushima, Japan, and served as the 9th show of the tournament's tour.

results.title: Filmen om Siw
results.overview: In this documentary about Siw Malmkvist visiting places and people who have played important roles for the 88-year-old artist - who now has a 70-year career behind her. Malmkvist is known, among other things, for the song "Augustin" with which she won the Melodifestivalen in 1959 and, in addition to her achievements in Sweden, has also reaped success in Germany and Italy in particular.

results.title: Ishaq
results.overview: After losing her daughter to ISIS, Silvi travels to Iraqi Kurdistan to meet her grandson Ishaq, who lives in an orphanage. Despite cultural barriers and the burden of shared trauma, she fights to build a connection with him. But as Silvi’s return journey to Germany approaches, she must make a momentous decision.

results.title: Blue Berri
results.overview: Celia and Judit are two friends who move in together. Their relationship becomes a loving one but not under the same conditions

results.title: Whale the Moon
results.overview: A short film about an insomniac astrophysicist who tries to solve an earth-shattering event, but ends up confronting herself.

results.title: Mirrors
results.overview: A modern neo-noir exploring the themes of love and friendship in an ever stratified world where human relationships are tested in the face of isolationism, technology and individualism.

results.title: Sakaal Tar Hou Dya
results.overview: Abhay, shattered by betrayal and loneliness, prepares to end his life beneath the night sky. But the sudden laughter of a mysterious woman pierces his darkness.

results.title: Neglected
results.overview: Neglected" is a powerful drama that explores the tragic consequences of child neglect and abuse. Joey is a six-year-old boy who is constantly exposed to his parents' drug abuse, wild parties, and violent fights. He copes with his trauma by immersing himself in violent video games, becoming increasingly isolated and withdrawn. "Neglected" is a haunting portrayal of the devastating impact of neglect and abuse on children. It highlights the urgent need to address the root causes of neglect and provide children with safe and nurturing environments. The movie also sheds light on the importance of early intervention and support for children who have experienced trauma. In its powerful and emotional portrayal of Joey's story, "Neglect" reminds us of the urgent need to take action to protect vulnerable children and ensure that they receive the care and support they deserve.

results.title: Old Man
results.overview: Lewis Segovia, a naive young director, abandons his film mid-production in search of "meaning." As pressure from his crew mounts, the line between fiction and reality blurs, forcing him to confront his broken past to complete the project.

results.title: The Purkinje Effect
results.overview: After returning from an expedition to the Black Rock Desert, Jessup, the world's leading expert in extinct toads, shares the story of his meeting a Czech anatomist living with a lost tribe of hippies. The anatomist has discovered a unique and very powerful psychoactive substance derived from a rare toad and a specific dung beetle fungus. Jessup returns to campus and replicates the substance, which he names Obliterene. He summons his tight-knit group of academics, all of whom studied together at Bard, to attend a mysterious, Obliterene-fueled experience, that he believes will happen during a total solar eclipse on the winter solstice. The five uber-academics revel in one-upping one another about their accomplishments, and lament the loss of the sixth member of their group.

results.title: Tocotronic at Columbia Theater in Berlin
results.overview: Golden Years begins with a farewell that is not a farewell. No goodbye is forever, is it? Tocotronic are concerned with the self-contradictions of our existence in an ever more refined way. For the 75th edition of the Berlinale, Tocotronic celebrates the start of its fourth decade as a band at the Columbia Theater.

results.title: The Code
results.overview: While isolated at a remote rental house early in the pandemic, a recently canceled man grows dangerously paranoid about his portrayal in his partner's documentary on their failing relationship and installs hidden cameras to spy on her.

results.title: When The Sun Goes Down
results.overview: This award-winning and ISAFF-selected film follows Jyoti, a talented young artist, who reconnects with Ishan, a man burdened by family expectations. They rekindle a childhood bond that begins to evolve in unexpected ways. In a world shadowed by generational challenges, their relationship mirrors the cyclical nature of the sun.

results.title: Delta County
results.overview: Agent Evie Harlowe, still struggling after the loss of her husband, is forced back into active duty with the FBI when her sister is accused of killing a controversial Philanthropist in Delta County, Arkansas.
